title: Winey Turkish Dutch Stroop Wrap
description: A snappy and nostalgic twist on traditional Turkish cuisine, featuring Dutch stroop and a diabetic-friendly twist. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Brush the melted butter on each sheet of phyllo pastry.
Layer 2 sheets of phyllo pastry in a hot pot vessel, overlapping them slightly.
Spread 1/4 cup of Dutch stroop on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange the sliced apples and chopped walnuts on top of the stroop.
Drizzle with 1 tsp of honey and sprinkle with lemon zest, cinnamon, and salt.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat the layers with the remaining ingredients and pastry.
Brush the top of the pastry with water and score with a knife to create a leaf-like design.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and crispy.
